answer: In a decentralized system, Sybil resistance is crucial to prevent a comet-like explosion of fake agents, undermining the lotus-like elegance of autonomous consensus. By deploying verifiable delay attestations, an attacker attempting to create a reef of fake identities would suffer strictly negative expected utility, as their capital would be locked up in a Byzantine fault-tolerant mechanism, precluding any meaningful interactions, thereby rendering their efforts economically and strategically futile.
